about: Every measured number the brain uses, with provenance (V2_STRATEGY.md rule 1, DEV_WORKFLOW.md). Runtime quantities (table plane, can size, palm-to-can offset, tracking baseline) are measured per order and logged, never stored here. Frames: pelvis = x ahead, y left, z up, metres; forearm = along the wrist-roll axis.

palm_real_m.method: g1-fetch ee_offset_x 0.15 (URDF wrist-roll origin to the model palm) + 0.096 from jog_x.py step 4 chosen by the owner's eye (hand beside the can, 2 cm steps); re-measured 2026-10-21 as -0.097

palm_half_height_m.method: assumed from the BrainCo hand's palm width; the pinky edge sat at the table on trial 8 (dz -0.02) with no harm. MEASURE with the tape

grasp_below_mid_m.method: palm centre below the can mid-height: trial 8 at -0.02 was the deepest wrap, trials 5-7 at +0.03/+0.01/0 held; V2_STRATEGY.md section 5

palm_to_axis_m.method: palm face r + 1 cm from the can axis (g1-fetch grab_can, kept through 12 holds)

pregrasp_standoff_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 5 (v1 used 0.05 with a blind slide; the servo frame needs the hand near the can)

can_diameters_m.method: slim / standard, classified from the box width at the box depth with a 60 mm threshold (73 mm measured for a 66 mm can)

torso_bands.method: torso_link.STL, waist_support_link.STL, pelvis.STL vertex extents per height band, placed by the g1_body23.urdf joints (stdlib STL reader)

clearance_m.frame: segment centre lines to the torso bands: lower upper arm, forearm, hand (wrist to fingertips), hand to the right arm
clearance_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 3 thresholds; the upper-arm value from the logged poses (grasps 1.7-3.4 cm, the 030059 misses 0.7-1.0, the Oct 19 block inside); re-check with replay_reach.py

pitch_max_deg.method: V2_STRATEGY.md section 3: beyond 15 deg of droop the real palm drops 1-2 cm below the level-forearm assumption

ik_tol_m.method: V2_STRATEGY.md: the hard-yaw IK either solves or not; v1's 0.035 accepted a full can radius of error

lift_m.method: 6 cm lift with correction reached within 3-7 mm on every grasp

offer_delta_m.method: the offer pose used on every v1 handover (grab_loop back-up, 2026-10-19/21); moved forward/inward/up until the hand is inside the head camera's view

camera_pose.frame: pelvis: x, y, z of the D435 link and its pitch down
camera_pose.method: g1_body23.urdf d435_joint (0.0576, 0.0175, 0.41987 from torso_link, rpy 0 0.8308 0) + torso_link at (-0.004, 0, 0.054)

pelvis_height_m.method: g1-fetch floor_height 0.98 m for a can point at z 0.14 (2026-10-21 logs)

contact_rise_rad.frame: joint tracking error above the per-pose baseline
contact_rise_rad.method: v1 contact stop; in v2 a safety abort only (fired once wrongly 6.6 cm from the can, live7.log)

hold_signature.frame: BrainCo finger q: thumb below, fingers between
hold_signature.method: 12 holds: thumb 0.07-0.22, at least three fingers 0.41-0.61 (V2_STRATEGY.md section 5)

hand_feature_K.frame: hand feature offsets from the can axis along (forearm d, palm normal n, z): fingertip front, nearest face, median height
hand_feature_K.method: NOT MEASURED: step 1 of the v2 plan (the kill test). Measure at the ALIGNED PRE-GRASP (palm centred on the can in d and z by the owner's eye, the standoff along n): the servo compares like with like there; at the closure pose the can hides part of the hand from the head camera (mock: the front feature shifts 0.9 cm). Until then the brain measures and logs the offsets but does not servo
